fusions.name: Arcane Discharge
fusions.desc: Needs one of your afflictions on the target: fires a raw arcane charge that deals 9 damage, consuming every affliction on it and adding half their remaining damage, with a 30% chance to leave the target [Exposed] for 5 seconds.

fusions.name: Unbound Detonation
fusions.desc: Fires every charged chamber at once in a ring, dealing 28 damage to every enemy within 3.5 tiles and ignoring their resistances.

fusions.name: Mana Primer
fusions.desc: Restores 3 mana a second for 8 seconds.

fusions.name: Stray Arcana
fusions.desc: Each time you spend mana, a bolt leaps to the nearest enemy within 8 tiles, dealing 6 damage. Once every 3 seconds.
